arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /bin/bash -lc 'set -Eeuo pipefail
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
python3 - <<"PY"
import os,sys,shutil,stat,hashlib,tempfile,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
live=Path("/opt/telegram-robot-leads")
src=live/".rea-fix-status-20261030"
verified=(live/".verified-source-commit").read_text().strip()
current=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(src),"rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
assert verified==current=="655a911595fd49b0eaeb4feec4dc5a0fb4ac61e0", "source sha mismatch"
source=src/"tests";target=live/"tests"
assert source.is_dir() and target.is_dir()
assert not source.is_symlink() and not target.is_symlink()
def allowed(p):
 assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.parent in (source,target),str(p)
 assert p.name.endswith(".py") and p.name.startswith(("test_","__init__")),str(p)
 assert p.stat().st_size<3_000_000
srcs={q.name:q for q in source.iterdir() if q.is_file() and q.name.endswith(".py")}
dests={q.name:q for q in target.iterdir() if q.is_file() and q.name.endswith(".py")}
for p in [*srcs.values(),*dests.values()]: allowed(p)
assert len(srcs)>=15 and len(srcs)<=45 and len(dests)<=45
backup=live/".rea-tests-backup-655a9115-20261030"
assert not backup.exists(), "backup already exists"
shutil.copytree(target,backup,symlinks=False,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__","*.pyc"))
changes=[];removed=[]
def put(dst,content,mode):
 fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".rea-test-",dir=str(target))
 try:
  with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as out:out.write(content)
  os.chmod(tmp,mode)
  os.replace(tmp,dst)
 finally:
  if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
try:
 for name,origin in sorted(srcs.items()):
  data=origin.read_bytes()
  dest=target/name
  if name not in dests or dest.read_bytes()!=data:
   put(dest,data,stat.S_IMODE(origin.stat().st_mode))
   changes.append(name)
 for name,dest in sorted(dests.items()):
  if name not in srcs and name.startswith("test_"):
   dest.unlink()
   removed.append(name)
 for name,origin in srcs.items():
  assert (target/name).read_bytes()==origin.read_bytes(),name
 print("SYNCHRONIZED_FROM",current,flush=True)
 print("TESTS_UPDATED",len(changes),",".join(changes),flush=True)
 print("OBSOLETE_TESTS_ARCHIVED",len(removed),",".join(removed),flush=True)
 print("TEST_BACKUP_CREATED",backup,flush=True)
 cmd=[str(live/".venv/bin/python"),"-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_*.py","-q"]
 run=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=live,env={**os.environ,"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE":"1"},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
 print("SUITE_EXIT",run.returncode,flush=True)
 print("SUITE_RESULT",(run.stdout+run.stderr)[-2600:],flush=True)
 assert run.returncode==0,"suite failed"
 assert "Ran 221 tests" in run.stderr+run.stdout,"unexpected test count"
 assert "OK" in run.stderr+run.stdout
 print("TEST_SYNC_PASS",flush=True)
except Exception as error:
 print("SYNC_FAILED_ROLLING_BACK",type(error).__name__,str(error)[:180],flush=True)
 for name in set(changes+removed):
  previous=backup/name
  dst=target/name
  if previous.is_file():put(dst,previous.read_bytes(),stat.S_IMODE(previous.stat().st_mode))
  elif dst.is_file():dst.unlink()
 print("ROLLBACK_RESTORED",flush=True)
 raise
PY
echo PM2_LIVE_STATUS
pm2 jlist | python3 -c '"'"'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print([(x.get("name"),x.get("pm2_env",{}).get("status"),x.get("pm2_env",{}).get("restart_time")) for x in d if x.get("name")=="telegram-robot-leads"])'"'"'
echo VERIFIED_TEST_SYNC_END
'
